title: automate-changelog-and-onboard-orion-lite-6b-v1.3
author: Priya Nair
body: Summary: Add onboarding metadata and performance profiles for orion-lite-6b v1.3 and extend changelog automation to pick up model registry metadata changes. Motivation: orion-lite-6b v1.3 includes backend tokenizer fixes and an improved KV-cache-friendly layout; customers on Dedicated asked for the variant to be available with curated perf profiles and automated changelog entries. This PR does three things: 1) add model metadata (model card, weights manifest, inference hints) for orion-lite-6b v1.3; 2) add per-hardware perf profiles (cpu/gpu/quantized) and small sample workloads used for profiling; 3) extend the changelog automation pipeline so that model-registry updates automatically create draft release notes and link to performance profiles. Checklist: * [x] Model metadata JSON (manifest and card) added under models/orion-lite/6b/v1.3/ * [x] Performance profile JSONs for a100-80g, t4, and cpu-32core added under models/orion-lite/6b/v1.3/perf-profiles/ * [x] Unit tests for perf profile schema validation added * [x] Changelog automation: new step to detect model-registry metadata changes and append bullet to changelog draft * [x] CI: integration run with perf-job simulation passed Local testing: ran profile generation tool with sample traces, validated inference hints against runtime validator, and ran changelog automation pipeline locally to ensure entries are formatted to the release notes template Backwards compatibility and rollout: the runtime already supports previous orion-lite variants. Adding v1.3 is non-breaking; the automation changes only append to the changelog draft and require no infra changes. Follow-ups: wire the automation draft commit to the release pipeline (separate PR), add canary perf runs on Dedicated in next sprint, and publish explicit model deprecation notes when we bump defaults. Commands to reproduce profiling used in validation: ./tools/profile-gen --model models/orion-lite/6b/v1.3 --hardware a100-80g --batch 8 --seq 512 ./tools/validate-metadata models/orion-lite/6b/v1.3/metadata.json CI: this landed behind a feature flag in the changelog action so it can be toggled if needed.
commits: b1f4e2d: add orion-lite-6b v1.3 metadata (card + manifest)
d4c9a8b: add perf profiles for a100-80g, t4 and cpu-32core
9a7f1c2: add schema validation tests for perf profiles
3c5b2ff: extend changelog automation to detect model-registry updates
6d2b4e1: docs: update model registry README with onboarding checklist
review_comments: Ethan Liu (reviewer): Please include the profiler config used to generate the a100 profile so we can reproduce latency numbers.
Priya Nair (author): Added the profiler command used in the PR body and included the sample trace in an internal bucket reference (access: infra-team).
Marta Ruiz (reviewer): The manifest looks good. One nit: can you make the 'recommended_quant' field more explicit about supported kernels?
Priya Nair (author): Updated metadata.json to include recommended_quant -> [int8, fp16] and added a note about kernel compatibility in ONBOARDING.md.
Lucas Chen (reviewer): CI failed initially on the schema test due to a missing field in t4 profile. Can you add a fallback key to maintain validator compatibility?
Priya Nair (author): Fixed t4 profile and added schema migration helper in validation tests; re-ran CI and green.
Marta Ruiz (approver): LGTM once CI is green. Approving for merge.
merge_outcome: Merged by Marta Ruiz using squash merge. Commit message: 'onboard(orion-lite-6b): v1.3 metadata + perf profiles + changelog automation step'
release_notes: Added orion-lite-6b v1.3 to model registry with curated performance profiles for a100-80g, t4, and cpu-32core. Changelog automation now detects model-registry metadata changes and appends draft release notes. See models/orion-lite/6b/v1.3/ for details.
notes_for_ops: No infra changes required. Changelog automation change is behind feature flag 'changelog.model_registry'. If unexpected drafts are created, flip the feature flag in the release-actions workflow and open ENG-4121.
observability_changes: Added perf labels (model=orion-lite-6b, model_version=v1.3) to telemetry emitted by profile-runner; dashboards will pick these up automatically.
